info.title: lc.cx Universal API
info.description: Create, manage, and measure short links with lc.cx

post.description: Creates a new short link in lc.cx.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

destination.description: The destination URL for the new shortlink.

domainId.description: The domain ID to use for the new shortlink.

customPath.description: An optional custom path for the shortlink.

tagIds[].description: Optional tag IDs to attach to the shortlink.

note.description: An optional note stored on the shortlink.

rule.description: An optional lc.cx rule value for the shortlink.

expirationTimestamp.description: An optional UNIX timestamp after which the shortlink expires.

expirationUrl.description: An optional URL to use after the shortlink expires.
